_help: One world, several Synapses. world.py reads this file. 'instances': 'auto' - as many as the PC can hold (up to max_instances), or a number. Senses: grow - the eyes take over from the direct senses as they learn (as a child); human - only what a person has (vision, hearing, touch, the body, the HUD); full - the direct senses + the eyes. The first AI plays in the big window you watch; the others in small windows in the background.

server._reaction_ticks: How many game ticks a brain may think before the world moves on (the world's pace adapts to the slowest brain). 5 = a person's quarter second at normal speed; 10 = the world twice as fast, reactions half a second of game time.
server._max_tick_rate: At night with monsters the server cannot keep 150-200 ticks a second (it fell 5-9 s behind): 120 at most.

_gamerules: keepInventory: things are kept on death (the childhood rule - fear, pain and death stay, only the things are not lost). Remove it for the full game.
_pace: tick_rate: the pace at start (20 is normal Minecraft). max_tick_rate: world.py then runs the world as fast as the brains keep up - their thinking stays within ~5 ticks, a person's reaction time - up to this. step_ms: the pause between moments. vision: the picture's size, zones of understanding, neurons of the visual cortex.
_limits: The minds have no ceilings of their own: concepts, chains, skills and the memory of every moment grow while there is room. disk_gb: the whole project (worlds, lives, clients, episodic memories) stays within this; keep_free_gb: always left free on the drive; keep_ram_gb: RAM a brain never takes for growing.
_knowledge: What may come ready-made, not from the AI's own life (knowledge.py). false shuts a channel: guide - the Minecraft Wiki; recipes - the game's reference of recipes and tools; path - advancements, tool tiers and new worlds as growth; imitation - watching people; speech - people's words as beliefs; books - game books as beliefs; childhood - habits grown in MiniCraft before birth. Here for everyone; an AI can have its own "knowledge" too. Every start is written to life/<name>/runs/.
_generation: A generation is born together (generation.py, world/generation.json): the world's spawn moves to dry forest ground near spawn_near, untouched; the first safe_days game days no monsters come (hunger, water, falls and the fear of the dark stay). A new generation: move world/generation.json away.

ais.name: Synapse3
ais._why: The control: nothing ready-made - no guide, reference, path, imitation, words, books or childhood; only the innate and his own life. Senses as Synapse1, to compare.

_fps: Frames a second of the big window and of the background ones. A moment's senses and eyes wait for the next frame, so more frames make every thought quicker (and the world faster); step_ms is the rest after each action.
